a bond graph model was used to analyze the gathering chains of a whole-stork sweet sorghum header, the model was validated, and the model results were used to determine design modifications to the gathering chains which will improve operation.
a hydraulic circuit was developed for the gathering chains of a sweet sorghum whole-stalk harvester, and that the circuit was modeled using bond graph techniques.

the load on the two motors driving the gathering chains was not evenly distributed and that the load could be reduced by removing the external drain line from the second motor and reducing the number of motors driving the chains.

the development of a bond graph model of the hydraulic system of a whole-stork sweet sorghum harvestor and the use of this model in the analysis of this system.
the development of a bond graph model to simulate the operation of the hydraulic system of a whole-stork sweet sorghum harvesting machine.
the design and development of a sweet sorghum whole stalk harvester.
